headline: Neon sticks it to A24 by announcing a Creative Commons SCP Foundation movie
summary: A24 angered the SCP community by not following Creative Commons rules for its film. Neon is producing its own SCP Foundation movie under a Creative Commons license. This move is seen as a PR win for Neon against A24.

headline: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its new frontier AI model. It boasts advanced performance in engineering, legal, finance, and cybersecurity. Access is currently restricted to 'trusted cyber defenders' due to its high capabilities.

headline: The AI Tamagotchis are coming
summary: AI has struggled in dedicated physical devices despite its success on phones and computers. Meta and OpenAI plan to launch physical AI hardware with 'cutesy software agents'. They aim to test consumer interest in these new AI-powered devices.

headline: Reddit says it has to cut back access to ‘Old Reddit’ because of AI bots
summary: Reddit is further limiting access to its 'Old Reddit' interface. This measure is to combat AI scraping and automated traffic. Users will soon need to be logged in and have an established account to use Old Reddit.

headline: 24 Jump Street Gets December 2027 Release Date, Original Cast Returning
summary: The long-awaited sequel, 24 Jump Street, finally has a release date. It is set to hit theaters in December 2027. Original stars Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum are confirmed to return.

headline: Alan Ritchson Confirmed to Star in Helldivers Movie as Release Date Pushed Back
summary: Reacher star Alan Ritchson is confirmed to play a Helldiver in the game's film adaptation. The Helldivers movie's release date has been pushed back. It is now slated for 2028.

headline: The Zarimi Cordless Electric Air Duster for PC Maintenance Drops to $19.79 Ahead of Prime Day
summary: The Zarimi Cordless Electric Air Duster is on sale for $19.79. This deal comes ahead of Prime Day. It offers a reusable alternative to compressed air canisters for PC cleaning.

headline: Crimson Desert Charting the Unknown Expansion Delayed Two Weeks
summary: Crimson Desert's 'Charting the Unknown' expansion faces a two-week delay. The expansion was recently announced with an ambitious October 15 release. The original target proved too soon for the developers.

headline: Dame Esther Rantzen: A presenter who campaigned for change
summary: Dame Esther Rantzen was a veteran broadcaster with a long career. She was known for her street interviews and national campaigns. Rantzen often spearheaded emotional reunions and advocated for significant social change.

headline: UK believes Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident, PM says
summary: The UK Prime Minister states belief in Iran's involvement in an RAF Fairford incident. Iran's foreign minister refuted the claim. He suggested the PM was 'barking up the wrong tree.'

headline: UK-France 'one in, one out' migrant scheme scrapped
summary: The 'one in, one out' migrant scheme between the UK and France has been abolished. The program had been in effect for over a year. Approximately 1,500 people were removed to France under the scheme.

headline: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
summary: MI5 warns that China is funding UK research and relaying it to its intelligence agencies. British universities are urged to cut ties with China General Technology Research Institute. This institute is linked to China's Ministry of State Security.
